caption:
Every lead you get is running two clocks at once.

Clock one starts the second they reach out. It only measures how fast a real reply gets to them.

Clock two starts after that first reply. It runs for days and tracks whether you keep showing up until they decide.

Most shops protect one clock and lose the other. Fast reply, then silence. Or persistent follow-up, but so slow out of the gate the lead already picked someone else.

Run both this week:

1. Every lead gets a real reply inside 5 minutes, every channel, every day.

2. Build a cadence of at least 5 touches over 10 days before you call a lead dead.

DM TRIAL

#SpeedToLead #ServiceBusiness #LeadFollowUp #ContractorMarketing #CRM
rationale: 2026 benchmarks confirm carousels still win saves/depth for B2B authority content, and this ships an unclaimed dual-timer mental model (attention clock + trust clock) distinct from every stage, ladder, matrix, cadence, decay, and cost framework already shipped.
